source_document.body:
The seasonal savings won’t be slowing down anytime soon, with this week’s Green Deals kicking off led by the exclusive deals for Anker’s SOLIX S5000 Power Station and bundles starting from $2,470 . There’s also Navee’s Early Access Black Friday EV Sale, with offers like the ST3 Pro City Commuter Electric Scooter down at a $552 low , among others. It’s also the last day to jump on Lectric’s Stocking Stuffer Accessory Sale with bonus extra savings, while Worx’s budget-friendly 40V 17-inch Cordless 2-in-1 Intellicut Mower is at a new $210 low . We’ve got more from Greenworks and other brands waiting for you down below, including last week’s best deals rounded up together in our latest Electrified Weekly edition .
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Anker’s new SOLIX S5000 power stations see up to $2,380 exclusive early Black Friday savings from $2,470
As part of Anker’s ongoing SOLIX Early Black Friday deals , you can find the recently released S5000 Portable Power Station and bundles starting from an exclusive $2,469.99 shipped , after using our exclusive code 9TO5DEALS5 at checkout, beating Amazon’s pricing by $125 . This model just hit the market at the end of October with a $3,600 MSRP, which we saw launch at $2,500 that dropped to $2,375 with our exclusive savings code. While those initial deals ended, you’re still getting a solid $1,130 of combined savings during this sale – and if you’re a member, you’ll receive 2x reward points, too, with FREE solar panel gifts accompanying orders over $3,000.
***Note: All the prices you see below have had our bonus extra savings factored in, so make sure to use our exclusive code 9TO5DEALS5 at checkout for the absolute best deals during this launch event.
Advertisement - scroll for more content
Anker’s SOLIX S5000 power station launch bundle deals:
S5000 (5,024Wh) power station: $2,470 (Reg. $3,600)
S5000 (5,024Wh) with 400W Bifacial solar panel: $2,945 (Reg. $4,400)
S5000 (5,024Wh) with 2x 400W solar panels: $3,420 (Reg. $5,200)
S5000 (10,048Wh) with expansion battery: $4,370 (Reg. $6,100)
S5000 (10kWh) with expansion battery + 400W solar panel: $4,845 (Reg. $6,900)
S5000 (10kWh) with expansion battery + 2x 400W panels: $5,320 (Reg. $7,700)
You can learn all about this new 5kWh power station here .
Navee early Black Friday deals offers ST3 Pro city commuter e-scooter at $552 low (Reg. $950), more from $408
Navee has its Black Friday Early Access deals running strong , complete with the sitewide bonus savings code NAVEEPR15 providing an extra 15% savings at checkout. One of my top picks, which I’ve been riding since going hands-on in my review , is the ST3 Pro Ultra-Comfort City Commuter Electric Scooter down at $552.49 shipped , after using the above code, beating out Amazon by $158 . Down from $950, we’ve seen this model keep above $760 for a large portion of the year, with more recent sales dropping the cost to $700, and as low as $650, which we saw during Prime Day. That deal is coming back around, with the bonus savings code cutting a combined $398 from the tag for the best price we have tracked.
You can check out our top picks during this sale in our original sale coverage here .
Lectric flash sale cuts up to 75% off stocking stuffer e-bike accessories starting from $15
Alongside the ongoing Lectric Black Friday e-bike deals , the brand has launched its annual Stocking Stuffer Accessory Flash Sale , complete with an extra 15% savings using the code EXTRA15 at checkout. If you’ve been cruising around on a Lectric model and want to deck it out, now is the time to do so with these deals. Using the code, you can pick up handy additions like a Phone Mount down at $24.65 shipped , or go big with the Pet Trailer at $101.15 shipped , and so many other options.
You can check out the lineup of Lectric’s accessory deals here until midnight tonight!
This 40V 17-inch cordless Worx mower has 2-in-1 bagging/mulching + self-adjusting power at a new $210 low (Reg. $300)
Amazon is currently offering the Worx 40V 17-inch 2-in-1 Cordless Electric Lawn Mower with 2x 4.0Ah batteries down at $209.99 shipped . While it used to have a $380 MSRP, these days this package only goes as high as $300, which we’ve mostly seen keep between $280 and $250 this year. More recently the discounts have dropped things as low as $214 in early September, with the deal here giving you a larger $90 markdown for a new all-time low price.
All in on Greenworks? Snag its 24V 22-inch cordless hedge trimmer at the $60 annual low (Reg. $100)
For folks with a Greenworks arsenal, Amazon is offering the chance to grab the 24V 22-inch Cordless Laser Cut Hedge Trimmer (tool only) down at $59.99 shipped . Down from $100, this model has been keeping at this price following October’s Prime Day event, which happens to be the lowest price we have tracked all year. You’re getting $40 cut from the tag for that best 2026 price, which makes it a steal for folks with batteries they can use to power it, otherwise the package with the hedge trimmer and a 4.0Ah battery can be found for $146.48 shipped , down from $160.
Bluetti early Black Friday lineup offers new 2,560Wh Apex 200 power station at exclusive $1,044, more from $429
Whisker offers up to $200 Litter-Robot savings during Black Friday Sale starting from $564
Ride1Up’s three VORSA e-bikes hit lows starting from $1,345 in Black Friday Sale, more rides from $845

Best new Green Deals landing this week
The savings this week are also continuing to a collection of other markdowns. To the same tune as the offers above, these all help you take a more energy-conscious approach to your routine. Winter means you can lock in even better off-season price cuts on electric tools for the lawn while saving on EVs and tons of other gear.
